~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ fw25-ctxm FW context ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
changeto context NOVA33
config terminal
!
!
object-group network VRF_NOVA-WLAN31_Subnets
  network-object 10.45.56.64 255.255.255.224
!
access-list NOVA-WLAN31_access_in extended permit ip 10.45.56.64 255.255.255.224 any
!
route NOVA-WLAN31 10.45.56.64 255.255.255.224 10.45.55.246 1
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ vss-a25-l25 FW contex and building router vss ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan 649
  name BLDF01-LINK33=NOVA-WLAN31
!
interface Port-channel7
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 649
!
interface vlan649
  description BLDF01-LINK33=NOVA-WLAN31
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding NOVA-WLAN31
  ip address 10.45.56.94 255.255.255.224
  ip helper-address 10.32.57.4
  no shutdown
!
ip route 10.45.56.64 255.255.255.224 10.45.54.17 name NOVA33:BLDF01-LINK33=NOVA-WLAN31
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 

! ########### MULTICAST START ########### 
!
interface Vlan649
  ip pim sparse-mode
!
!copy running start
!
! ########### MULTICAST END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ bldg06-sw01-11 building distribution switch ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan 649
  name BLDF01-LINK33=NOVA-WLAN31
!
interface Port-channel1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 649
!
interface Port-channel2
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 649
!
interface Port-channel3
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 649
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END #############
